_doc: The slice plan as data (the producer skill's templates/plan.json documents every key). Written 2026-09-14 from DESIGN.md sections 2, 5 and 6 after the slice shipped, so the checks are the exit tests made checkable, and M8 and M9 are the work after M7 as the docs describe it.
name: Neon Debt

tests.fail_if: Parse Error|Failed to load script|Compile Error
tests._doc: The GUT suite: 468 tests in about 230 s on 2026-09-14; exit 0 when green. fail_if is CI's guard: a script that fails to parse is skipped, not failed, and GUT still prints All tests passed.

boot._doc: The CI boot smoke: the main scene loads headless and quits.

milestones.title: Skeleton
milestones.deliverable: A Godot project that runs headless and windowed, with the input map, the signal bus, GUT and CI, and one empty test room.
milestones.risk: The engine and the agent workflow: text scenes, headless tests, a green CI before any feature exists.

milestones.title: Movement feel
milestones.deliverable: The full controller (run, jump, dash, wall slide, coyote, buffer) tuned from one resource, in a gym with platforming challenges.
milestones.risk: The genre lives or dies on the jump; nothing downstream is worth building until moving around an empty room is fun.

acceptance.what: moving around an empty room is fun

milestones.title: Combat core
milestones.deliverable: Melee and ranged against a training dummy and the Scav: the damage pipeline, hitstop, knockback, i-frames, death, in a lab room.
milestones.risk: Whether three verbs sharing one pipeline can feel different; whether the first enemy teaches spacing.

acceptance.what: fighting three Scavs is legible and satisfying

milestones.title: RPG layer
milestones.deliverable: Stats, XP and levels, the ten items as resources, the equip screen, pickups and the level-up moment, in a gear-and-levels lab.
milestones.risk: Whether a gear swap produces a felt difference without trivialising enemies; the effective-stats layer the pipeline and the screen must share.

acceptance.what: equipping better gear visibly changes combat math

milestones.title: Hacks
milestones.deliverable: RAM, the three programs, the quickslot and a Breach-locked door, in a hacks lab.
milestones.risk: Whether all three verbs get used naturally in one fight, or hacks stay a menu nobody opens.

acceptance.what: all three combat verbs used naturally in one fight

milestones.title: The district
milestones.deliverable: The Stacks: 25 to 35 greybox rooms with doors, the map screen, save points, the ability pickups in order, the double-jump teases, the shortcut loop, the hub with Stitch and Marisol, and the fetch quest.
milestones.risk: Whether the loop plays end to end (explore, unlock, open what it gates, gear up, level, complete the quest) and whether every gate holds against the kit at that point.

milestones.title: Enemies and boss
milestones.deliverable: The Watcher drone, the Riot unit, the Elite Scav, and the Landlord with two phases in a sealed arena, ending the slice.
milestones.risk: Whether the boss is a wall worth climbing: beatable, demanding every verb, three to eight attempts for a decent player.

milestones.title: Slice polish
milestones.deliverable: The balance pass, the sound, the juice, the menus and settings, save and load hardened, a title screen with three slots, and a first art pass.
milestones.risk: Whether a stranger can run it start to finish without guidance.

acceptance._doc: One synchronized stream per track, which is what the engine loads. This check used to be game/assets/audio/music/*.ogg and read 0 from the day the composer landed: it writes a folder per track and a stem per layer, so the oggs are one level deeper. A stale glob, never a missing track.
The stems themselves: five tracks carrying at least four layers each.

acceptance.what: external playtesters run it start to finish without guidance

milestones.title: The look
milestones.deliverable: The hi-bit art pass on the slice: every character as a baked sheet, every room dressed and lit from its concept at the figure's scale, the effects baked like the characters, the HUD in the palette, all reviewed against the bible.
milestones.risk: Whether generated stills, rigs and bakes can hold one style across a cast and a district without a hand-drawn pass.

acceptance.what: the district reads as one style at 1:1

milestones.title: Go or no-go
milestones.deliverable: The slice in the hands of three to five people who owe nothing, and the decision to continue to V2 or not.
milestones.risk: Whether the game is worth building: the loop is readable, the pull works, the verbs are distinguishable, somebody wants more.

acceptance.what: testers finish without being told what to do
a tester asks how do I get up there
testers can say why they would pick melee, ranged or hacks
someone asks when they can play more
